$chapter.note: 2026-08-31: $mu_plugins moved out to its own chapter 22-mu-plugins. It documented only 5 of the 15 real MU files, and the boot layer is a big enough concern to own a chapter.

$routing_canonical.description: Public URL policy (May 2026). Implemented in plugin PHP and rewrites; registry documents behaviour only — not parsed for routing at request time.
$routing_canonical.root_slash: Guests: 301 to /casa (apollo-templates/includes/landing-router.php template_redirect priority 4). Logged-in: redirect to /feed (mural-router.php priority 5).
$routing_canonical.legacy_home: /home: guests 301 /casa; logged /feed (mural-router + landing-router query var apollo_home_redirect).
$routing_canonical.apollo_templates_priorities: landing-router P4, mural-router P5, main template handler P10 (apollo-templates.php).
$routing_canonical.apollo_core_front_route: FrontRouteDispatcher template_redirect P0 — reads wp-content/apollo-pages-rest.json for index/logging (not apollo-registry.json).
$routing_canonical.apollo_pane_engine: Default: pane lab at /painel-lab; /casa is apollo-templates guest landing unless APOLLO_PANE_PRIMARY forces pane to own /casa (see apollo-pane-engine/includes/functions.php).
$routing_canonical.error_funnel: apollo-error-handler.php template_redirect PHP_INT_MAX — late 404 to apollo.rio.br erro pages.
$routing_canonical.$mu_plugins_moved: The MU boot layer now lives in chapter 22-mu-plugins.json (15 files documented, was 5).

$third_party_plugins.description: Third-party WordPress plugins present in this aprio installation but not part of the Apollo ecosystem

loginizer.purpose: Login security: brute force protection, IP blocking, CAPTCHA, two-factor auth. Works alongside apollo-login security layer.

loginizer-security.purpose: Extended Loginizer security features. Companion to loginizer plugin.

really-simple-ssl.purpose: Automatic SSL/HTTPS enforcement and mixed content fixing.

query-monitor.purpose: Developer debugging: DB queries, hooks, HTTP requests, cache. Used with apollo-debug MU plugin.

wp-debugging.purpose: Enables WP_DEBUG, WP_DEBUG_LOG, SAVEQUERIES constants for development environments.
